title: Leaks and output
acceptance_criteria: checkpoint --resolve-question --answer is leak-checked, redacted under --redact and bounded at 4096 bytes (#364). Conflict-marker refusals and doctor findings name only the marker's seven characters (#365). An error shows a value a person gave only when it holds no leak and no control character, otherwise it names the field and what it holds (#367). The leak guard adds password JSON keys, SECRET_KEY and AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY assignments, xapp- and hf_ tokens, ~user/ paths, the macOS LocalHostName and its .local name, dotted host names inside hyphenated build names, and checks session new --module; evidence add --redact reports its count (#368). The user name comes from the account, and a system root such as /dev/ is never a user-name path (#379). gate record's refusal says Error: once (#380).

answers.constraints: Leif's decisions set the scope: #367 'approved. Errors name the field and the kind, never the offending text' and 'Show it only if clean'; #368 'approved. The leak guard adds all the listed forms…'; and for #364, #365, #379 and #380 'Yes, as each issue states'. #366 (escaping on print) is a later batch, so control characters are only kept out of error echoes here. No new dependency; matchers stay hand-written. Failing tests first.
